![PleebUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grimboso/PleebUI/main/PleebUI/Media/PleebUI.png)
# PleebUI

I developed PleebUI as an all-in-one UI addon for World of Warcraft Retail, built around the changes introduced with Midnight.

I wanted to have as much control over my interface as possible without having to install and configure a dozen different addons to get everything looking and working the way I wanted.

PleebUI has grown quite a bit since I started working on it. It now covers most of the interface I normally use, from Unit Frames and Action Bars to cooldown tracking, class resources, Damage Meters, Chat, and a bunch of smaller features.

Almost everything can be customized, and I've tried to make the configuration itself as straightforward as possible. Most visual changes are applied directly, and you can preview frames and other elements without having to enter combat or find a group.

I'm still actively developing it, fixing things I come across and adding features as I go.

## Accessibility

With version 1.6, I've put a lot of work into making PleebUI more accessible.

I've been using **WCAG 2.1** and the W3C's **WCAG2ICT guidance for non-web software** as references when developing the configuration interface and its controls.

The goal is to make the addon usable for people who might have trouble reading smaller text, distinguishing certain colors, using a mouse precisely, or navigating complicated interfaces.

Some of the accessibility features I've implemented include:

- **Keyboard navigation:** Navigate the options interface using Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Enter, and Space. This also covers supported dropdowns, dialogs, and other interactive controls.
- **Keyboard Edit Mode:** Move and position frames using the keyboard instead of dragging everything with the mouse. I've also added a guide where you can practice the controls.
- **Color vision presets:** Built-in presets for protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia, along with two high-contrast themes.
- **Contrast previews:** Preview color presets before applying them, including the calculated contrast ratio between text and background colors.
- **Text and font settings:** Adjust fonts, text sizes, outlines, and scaling globally or for individual parts of the UI.
- **Larger pointer targets:** Increase the size and spacing of smaller controls to make them easier to interact with.
- **Reduced motion:** Disable animations in the configuration interface.
- **Combat Readability preset:** Apply larger health and resource text, stronger outlines, clearer backgrounds, and larger aura icons across supported combat elements. The changes can also be undone.
- **Keyboard focus indicators:** Make it easier to see which control is currently selected when navigating without a mouse.

I've also included accessibility settings directly in the installation wizard, so you don't have to finish setting everything up before you can adjust the interface to something comfortable.

### WCAG compliance

I don't consider PleebUI fully WCAG compliant yet.

My current estimate is approximately **75% alignment with the applicable WCAG 2.1 criteria**, using the W3C's WCAG2ICT guidance for non-web software.

This is my own estimate, not the result of an independent accessibility audit or an official certification. Some limitations also come from World of Warcraft itself and what addons are allowed to control.

I'm continuing to improve this, and I'd particularly appreciate feedback from anyone using the accessibility features.

## What's included in PleebUI?

### Unit Frames

- Customizable Unit Frames for Player, Target, Focus, Pet, Boss, Party, and Raid.
You can change all the usual settings, and some unusual ones too. Respects accessibility settings and toggles in the options menu. I tried to make sane defaults for everyday use. 

Party and Raid frames have their own configuration options, including aura displays, dispel indicators, healing and absorb prediction, and layout settings.

I've also added previews and Test Mode so you can configure frames without needing an actual group.

### Action Bars

- Customization for Action Bars 1–12, along with Pet and Stance bars.
I added more action bars to allow the user to more easily move around binds, buttons and whatnot and spread them out as they wish. Respects accessibility settings and toggles in the options menu.

You can configure button sizes, spacing, layout, keybind text, visibility conditions, mouseover fading, backgrounds, and more.

There are also previews and a keybinding mode.

### Cooldown Manager and custom trackers

- Expanded on Blizzard's Cooldown Manager rather than trying to replace all of its underlying functionality.

PleebUI supports customization of the Essential, Utility, Buff Icon, and Buff Bar viewers, including individual icon settings, layouts, glows, colors, text, and positioning.

You can also create your own cooldown icons, duration bars, charge bars, and aura stack bars.
I have put a lot of focus on having the ability to use bars instead of icons to track all sorts of cooldowns, durations, stacks and whatnot, and I pre-built the most commonly (to my knowledge) used custom bars, at least when I look back at the old class weakaura packs and what my friends want to track when I ask them. You can of course disable all these. 

I've included a guided tracker setup, live previews, custom groups, and plenty of individual display settings.

### Consumable Tracker

A configurable tracker for supported combat consumables and items, including potions, Healthstones, combat resurrection items, equipped trinkets, and racial abilities.

You can configure the icons, cooldown displays, counts, glows, and visibility.

### Personal Resource Display

- Customizable Personal Resource Display for health, power, class resources, and supported tracked effects.

Resources have their own settings for sizing, colors, text, layout, and positioning.

The available resource options depend on your class and specialization, rather than showing settings for resources your character doesn't use.

### Damage Meters

PleebUI includes its own Damage Meters. I made it because it was fun. Doesnt do much that the default one does but I wanted to try to make one and not just skin the regular one. There are 100% better ones out there, but I liked having my own. 

Each window can show different supported combat statistics and segments.
I've also included player breakdowns, recent encounters, saved boss kills, and completed Mythic+ Overall sessions.

### Chat and Minimap

Customizable Chat features, including styling, font settings, timestamps, clickable links, message copying, and chat history. Chat is mostly handled more easily allow for accessibility settings such as custom fonts, colors and contrast settings. 

The Minimap can  be customized, with options for its appearance, addon buttons, coordinates, clock, zone text, and other details.

## Edit Mode

Separate Edit Mode for PleebUI, accessible using `/pe`.

You can move supported frames and bars around, adjust their positions, and use Smart Snap to align things or move connected elements together.

I've added keyboard movement, Undo/Redo, alignment guides, quick settings, and a searchable list of movable elements.

Supported Unit Frames can also have different saved positions depending on whether you're playing Solo, in a Party, or in a Raid.

## Commands

- `/pui` — Open PleebUI settings
- `/pui install` — Run the installation wizard
- `/pe` — Open PleebUI Edit Mode
- `/pek` — Open Edit Mode with keyboard movement
- `/kb` — Open Action Bar keybinding mode
- `/cd` — Open Blizzard Cooldown Manager settings
- `/dmg` or `/dps` — Control the Damage Meters

## For addon developers

I've also added a public API for addon developers who want to integrate with PleebUI.

Other addons can register their own configuration pages and Edit Mode movers while keeping ownership of their own frames and settings.

The API is documented in the GitHub repo. 

## Feedback and development

PleebUI is   being developed, and there's always something I'm working on or trying to improve.

If you find a bug, run into a Lua error, or notice something that doesn't work properly, please let me know. Include as much information as possible.

Suggestions are welcome too. I can't promise to implement everything, but I do read the feedback.

**GitHub:** https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI

**Discord:** https://discord.gg/ZESUvEUwV 

**Bug reports and feature requests:** https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/issues

Thanks for trying out PleebUI.

# PleebUI

## [v2.0.0](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/tree/v2.0.0) (2026-11-17)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/compare/v1.6.2...v2.0.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/releases)

- Add Classic-era UI and combat enhancements  
    Add threat meters, missing-buff indicators, pet happiness and weapon-buff warnings, and menu-bar styling with Edit Mode movers. Extend profession and minimap skins, and improve damage-meter formatting, action-bar range updates, and power-text refreshes.  
- Update PUI\_InstallerSettings.lua  
- Add Forever PRD extras and queued swing cues. Merge from Forevever.  
    Move the totem tracker into core for reuse by the cooldown manager and PRD. Add form-mana bars for druids, active totem displays for shamans, and queued melee attack highlighting in the swing timer.  
- Handle secret aura updates and cooldown swaps  
    Refresh cooldowns when charge counts change, and apply countdown-number visibility independently of other styling. Defer aura styling while buttons are inaccessible, update player aura layouts in place, and reapply pending settings when restrictions change.  
- Add WoW Classic support and new bar options  
    Add Classic client compatibility across unit frames, resource displays, cooldowns, damage meters, and Blizzard UI skins. Introduce configurable experience and swing timers, plus target name, level, difficulty-color, and classification options.  
- Handle missing primary resource text settings  
    Stop native text configuration when primary resource settings are unavailable, and source appearance text separately for primary and secondary bars.  
- Preserve mixed Blizzard skin settings  
    Migrate legacy settings to per-window values and show when a toggle group has mixed choices. Changing a group toggle applies the selection across its windows.  
- Add configurable profiler columns and grouping  
    Group profiler functions by assigned display labels and add selectable CPU and allocation metrics, including sorting by allocation averages and peaks.  
- Fix action bar refresh behavior  
    Refresh runtime settings through the shared helper, update pet-action usability consistently, and avoid redundant hotkey refreshes. Also register additional action-bar functions with Pleebug profiling.  
- Align chat module registration and fade state  
    Register ChatLinks under `ns.Modules` and update its consumers. Consolidate panel visibility and focus checks for fade handling, and remove an unused tab-owner reference.  
- Harden combat tool runtime and previews  
    Register CombatQuality under the shared module namespace, prevent stale or disabled owners from running queued jobs, and refine Hunter salve and movement warning preview behavior.  
- Optimize cooldown runtime and transitions  
    Refine cooldown event handling and charge-bar refreshes, preserve proc-glow animations when icons are hidden, and avoid unnecessary viewer and catalog updates during native settings changes.  
- Separate aura runtime shutdown from activation  
    Replace `SetRuntimeEnabled` with a shutdown-only helper and retain pending anchor state after applying positions.  
- Refine PRD profile and event handling  
    Route new-profile setup through the reset handler, simplify PRD module registration and mover refresh state, and streamline secondary adapter event and buff-cue detection.  
- Harden unit frame runtime scheduling  
    Prevent canceled runtime jobs from running after an owner is restarted, consolidate cast bar profiling labels, and simplify unit frame position settings by removing obsolete helpers.  
- Centralize disabled child addon pages  
    Replace duplicated disabled-addon page builders with a shared helper, and update ChatLinks and CombatQuality references to use the module registry.  
- Reuse shared disabled-addon options page  
    Replace the action bars-specific disabled panel with the shared disabled child-addon page, keeping its change-blocked check and enable callback.  
- Use module registry in installer checks  
    Check `ChatLinks` and `CombatQuality` availability through `ns.Modules` when building installer previews and settings, keeping optional-module behavior consistent.  
- Group Blizzard skin options by window  
    Consolidate related dialogs under their owning window toggles and migrate existing per-frame settings. Add coverage for more Blizzard windows, refresh-button styling, and single-line Group Finder search entries.  
- Unify damage meter window routing  
    Compile visible windows and meter-specific event routing in one pass, and streamline per-window configuration. Remove obsolete helper exports and redundant profile initialization.  
- Fix cast bar state and instant visuals  
    Centralize cast-time and target cleanup, refresh player instant-cast visuals after layout updates, and preserve delay-text configuration. Also defer player spellcast event handler setup until module initialization.  
- Restore module defaults and saved addon choices on profile changes  
- Use duration objects and separate instant castbar profiling  
- Track resource event and animation callbacks in PRD profiling  
- Apply damage meter settings through its own runtime host  
- Expose Hunter Tools defaults for profile restoration  
- Coalesce chat theme refreshes on the addon runtime host  
- Defer action bar refresh until entering the world  
- Add options UI profiling and grouped callback measurements  
- Improve Pleebug callback tracking, selection and profiler layout  
- Apply profile addon choices when completing setup  
- Let setup choose enabled addons for the current profile  
- Keep addon reload prompts consistent with profile and session state  
- Store child addon enable states in PleebUI profiles  
    Save child addon choices in each PleebUI profile and offer Apply and reload when a profile needs different addons.  
- Move Chat into a separate addon  
    Move Chat runtime and settings into PleebUI\_Chat, migrating history to its own saved database and preserving PleebUI profiles.  
- Move combat tools into a separate addon  
    Move combat warnings, reminders, indicators and group tools into PleebUI\_CombatTools while preserving existing settings locations.  
- Move Player Buffs into a separate addon  
    Move player buff and debuff displays into PleebUI\_PlayerBuffs with their own aura runtime and addon controls.  
- Move Unit Frames into a separate addon  
    Move unit frame runtime, settings and previews into PleebUI\_UnitFrames while retaining core profile defaults and shared styling.  
- Move Cooldown Manager into a separate addon  
    Move cooldown runtime, settings and previews into PleebUI\_CooldownManager with independent aura processing and profiling ownership.  
- Move Personal Resource Display into a separate addon  
    Move resource display runtime, settings and previews into PleebUI\_PRD, including its own tracked aura containers.  
- Move Damage Meters into a separate addon  
    Move Damage Meters runtime and settings into PleebUI\_DamageMeters while preserving saved data and PleebUI integration.  
- Move Action Bars into a separate addon  
    Move Action Bars runtime, settings and previews into PleebUI\_ActionBars while preserving PleebUI profiles and shared controls.  
- Improve Pleebug addon attribution and profiling controls  
    Keep the Pleebug addon attribution, profiling, display and export upgrades together.  
- Organize PleebUI and child addons as sibling folders  
    Track the installed PleebUI folder and its sibling addons directly, with release packaging limited to PleebUI files.  
- Group pet warning previews in the top row  
- Keep combat preview samples centered at their configured font sizes  
- Add runtime SLUG defaults and preview popup with shared scrollbar visibility  
- Add fixed combat timer background and border settings

## [v1.6.2](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/tree/v1.6.2) (2026-10-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/compare/v1.6.1...v1.6.2) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebUI/releases)

- Track embedded events via dispatcher frames  
    Observe module-owned NumyAceEvent frames when embedded event tracking is enabled, and safely handle missing CPU registries when building export rows.  
- Reopen options when refresh changes path  
    Refresh the active options session at the requested target path when it falls outside the current path, while preserving the existing queued refresh and after-select behavior.  
- Refine PRD bar layout and settings  
    Add per-bar spacing controls for adjacent stacked bars and expose shared or detached width in each bar's settings. Reorganize PRD settings, improve health display selection, and keep the preview aligned with runtime layout.  
- Stabilize unit-frame refreshes and option updates  
    Route unit-frame option updates through the lifecycle model, track embedded events for unit-frame modules, and defer raid aura-availability refreshes with cancellation on disable.  
- Refine PCM runtime refresh handling  
    Target keybind refreshes to affected spells and items, restore aura alpha after restricted updates, and improve spell-transition and options-tree refresh behavior.  
- Preserve pending aura styling across layers  
- Let current raid size override manual mover groups  
- Disable manual raid groups during automatic mover sizing  
- Size raid mover previews from the current raid  
- Refresh raid previews for group sizing settings  
- Add raid group and mover size quick settings  
- Default raid mover sizing to configured groups  
- Refresh action bar options selectively  
    Apply text, backdrop, cooldown, and runtime setting changes through targeted refreshes, including matching preview updates, instead of triggering broader action bar refreshes.  
- Refresh live options without reopening  
    Add lifecycle tracking and reconciliation for PleebUI's AceConfig widgets so model changes update visible controls and pages in place. Also restore tree-button layout after native refreshes and complete deferred startup layout when loading or combat ends.  
- Removed file  
- Organize edit mode modules  
    Move edit mode scripts into Core/EditMode and update Core.xml to load them from their new paths. Remove the obsolete startup module.
